reason: I'd sign up with the café's link and take the free collab, sure, but I already get free meals by just DMing places. Paying ₹499 so I can do more barter collabs feels backwards when the cafés pay me in food anyway.
objection: Local cafés pay in food, not money, so the pass doesn't earn me anything back. And making promo videos for 'participating businesses' sounds like extra unpaid work, and the café getting ₹150 makes their invite feel like a sales pitch.
would_change_my_mind: If my free collab through Mitra turned into an actual paid collab, or Auto-DM visibly pushed my insights up, I'd pay the ₹499.
